$comment: ERP frontend (frontend/, CRA + craco) built from a repo-rooted Vercel project. vercel.json OVERRIDES dashboard settings, so this neutralizes a stray Build Command override (e.g. 'react-scripts build', which exits 127 at the repo root — the root package.json is a dev-scripts helper with no react-scripts). Preferred setup remains Root Directory = frontend (then frontend/vercel.json governs and this file is ignored). CI=false: Vercel sets CI=1, which makes CRA treat lint warnings as build errors.
